summary: Nora now posts a "Now playing" notification (with a link to the video) whenever a track auto-advances, in the channel /music play was started from.
details: Previously, a track finishing naturally and the next one starting was silent in Discord -- only explicit commands (/music play, /music skip) got a reply. That transition now posts "Now playing: <title> — <url>" to the channel the session's first /music play was invoked from.
/music skip gets the same notification for the new now-playing track, alongside its existing "Skipped: X" reply.

The notification channel is captured once, when a guild's session actually starts (the first /music play that connects to voice) -- a later /music play reusing the session from a different channel does not move where notifications land.
limitations: If the session's original channel is deleted or Nora loses permission to post there, the notification silently fails to send -- there is no fallback channel.
